fact: La Nation, reporting the UNESCO-supported readiness assessment, says no law specifically addresses artificial intelligence in Djibouti to date, the Code du numerique being a data-protection frame.
The UNESCO-supported readiness diagnostic says no legislation dedicated to AI was in place in Djibouti, beyond the data protection framework of the Code du numerique.

Dr Houssein Ahmed Assoweh, author of the UNESCO readiness report, says Djibouti has no legal framework designed specifically for AI systems, though the Code du numérique and data-protection texts may apply; a framework law and an AI authority are only recommended.
